# AP News

> AP News is a comprehensive news organization delivering breaking news, latest headlines, and multimedia coverage across global politics, conflicts, US national affairs, and regional developments.

The Associated Press provides real-time news coverage spanning international conflicts (Iran, Russia-Ukraine, Middle East), US politics and policy, regional news hubs for Asia-Pacific, Europe, Latin America, and Africa, plus specialized coverage of immigration, weather, education, and transportation. AP News serves as a primary source for breaking news and investigative reporting on geopolitical tensions, government actions, and major events worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Iran nuclear conflict
- Russia-Ukraine war
- Middle East tensions
- US politics
- Israel-Iran relations
- Breaking news
- Geopolitics
- Military strikes
- International relations
- Trump administration
- Immigration and deportations
- Government policy
- Ukraine military updates
- Asia-Pacific coverage
- Climate and weather

## Breaking News & Homepage

- [Associated Press News: Breaking News, Latest Headlines and Videos](https://apnews.com): AP News homepage with breaking news, latest headlines, and international coverage
- [Newsletters](https://apnews.com/newsletters): Newsletter signup page for AP News alerts, Morning Wire, and sports coverage

## Global Conflicts & Geopolitics

- [World News: Top & Breaking World News Today](https://apnews.com/world-news): World news hub covering breaking stories from Iran, Ukraine, Middle East conflicts
- [Iran war](https://apnews.com/hub/iran): Iran conflict coverage including nuclear tensions and US-Iran relations
- [Russia-Ukraine | Breaking News & Live Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/russia-ukraine): Russia-Ukraine war coverage with live updates and military conflict reporting
- [Iran says its main nuclear enrichment facility is struck again](https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-israel-trump-lebanon-march-21-2026-260bac76e5554ff31aaf5a3a30c92a2e): Iran nuclear enrichment facility struck; tensions escalate with Israel and US
- [China | Latest News from China Today](https://apnews.com/hub/china): China news hub covering US-China relations, AI exports, and Asia-Pacific issues

## Regional News Hubs

- [Asia Pacific | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/asia-pacific): Asia-Pacific news hub with coverage of Japan, Korea, regional tensions
- [Europe News | Breaking European News Today](https://apnews.com/hub/europe): European news hub with coverage of EU politics, Russia-Ukraine, geopolitics
- [Latin American News | Latest Latin American News](https://apnews.com/hub/latin-america): Latin America news covering Colombian politics, drug trafficking, regional issues
- [Africa News Reports | Latest News in Africa](https://apnews.com/hub/africa): Africa news hub covering wildlife conservation, LGBTQ rights, regional reporting
- [Últimas Noticias del Mundo](https://apnews.com/hub/noticias): Spanish-language international news hub covering world conflicts and sports

## U.S. National News & Policy

- [U.S. News: Top U.S. News Today](https://apnews.com/us-news): US national news hub covering politics, disasters, law enforcement, weather
- [Immigration](https://apnews.com/hub/immigration): Immigration news hub covering deportations, asylum, ICE enforcement, policy
- [Abortion | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/abortion): Abortion news hub covering policy, state legislation, reproductive rights, cases
- [Education | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/education): Education news hub covering K-12, higher education, student loans, policy

## Environmental & Infrastructure Coverage

- [Weather, Hurricanes and Storms | Latest News & Updates](https://apnews.com/hub/weather): Weather news hub with hurricane, storm, flooding, and climate change coverage
- [Transportation](https://apnews.com/us-news/transportation): Transportation news covering transit funding, infrastructure, rail, federal policy
